notes: All numbers extracted from downloaded documents (soc_dl). 'secondary' = number quoted by another accessible paper; primary not accessed. Page refs are PDF pages unless 'journal page'.

findings.cite: Allcott H. (2012/2015) Site Selection Bias in Program Evaluation. NBER WP 18373 (QJE 2015)
findings.method: Randomized home energy reports with social comparison; meta-analysis of site ATEs
findings.interpretation_ja: 近所比較つき省エネレポートの効果は平均で電力使用量の約1.3%減（地点により0.5〜2.6%）。最初に導入した地域ほど効果が大きく、後から広げると効果は小さくなる（初期10地点は1.7%）。シミュレーターでは記述的規範メッセージの行動変化は「1〜2%程度」が上限目安。
findings.replication: 111 replications in the field; heterogeneity significant (Cochran Q p<0.001); effect declines in later sites (site selection bias)

findings.cite: Allcott H., Rogers T. (2014) The Short-Run and Long-Run Effects of Behavioral Interventions: Experimental Evidence from Energy Conservation. NBER WP 18492 (AER 2014)
findings.data: Opower home energy reports, >6 million households
findings.method: Long-run RCT incl. discontinuation arm

numbers.pattern: high-frequency action and backsliding after each early report, attenuating over time; slow habituation after 2 years

findings.interpretation_ja: 比較レポートを2年送った後に止めても、効果は年10〜20%ずつしか減衰しない（習慣化）。初期は報告直後に節電→徐々に元に戻るサイクルがある。
findings.replication: Body text of the NBER PDF uses an unreadable font encoding; only abstract numbers extracted

findings.cite: Hallsworth M., List J.A., Metcalfe R.D., Vlaev I. (2014) The Behavioralist as Tax Collector. NBER WP 20007 (J Public Econ 2017)
findings.data: HMRC administrative data; Exp.1 ~100,000 taxpayers, Exp.2 119,527; total >200,000
findings.method: Natural field experiments: reminder letters with norm / public-good messages; outcome = payment within 23 days

numbers.note: descriptive norms > injunctive norms in Exp.2; minority-norm effect replicated

findings.interpretation_ja: 「10人中9人は期限内に納税」に「あなたは少数派」を加えると納付率が+5.1ポイント（単なる規範は+1.3ポイント）。手紙そのものの効果は+6.7ポイント。規範メッセージは「自分が少数派だと気づかせる」と効く。
findings.replication: Minority norm effect replicated in second experiment within the paper
findings.page: pp.5-6 (Exp.1 effects), p.17 (letter effect), p.25 (control 33.6%) [PDF pages]

findings.cite: Bohner G., Schlüter L.E. (2014) A room with a viewpoint revisited: descriptive norms and hotel guests' towel reuse behavior. PLoS ONE 9(8):e104086
findings.data: Study1 N=724 (4-star hotel, 162 rooms); Study2 N=204; pilot N=64
findings.method: Field experiment replicating Goldstein, Cialdini & Griskevicius (2008)
findings.interpretation_ja: 米国の原典では規範メッセージで再利用率44%対35%（+9ポイント）だったが、ドイツの再現では規範メッセージは通常の環境メッセージより効かなかった。メッセージ自体（何か掲示すること）の効果は+15ポイント程度。文化・ベースラインで効果が消えうる。
findings.replication: Failed to replicate descriptive-norm advantage over standard message (also Reese et al. in AT/CH cited as mixed)
findings.page: Abstract; Results Study1 & Study2; Introduction (Goldstein numbers, secondary)

findings.cite: 松川勇 (2020) 家計に対する情報提供の省エネルギー効果―フィールド実験による検証―. 環境経済・政策研究 13(1):42-
findings.data: 京都府南部 571世帯 (2013, HER訪問指導) / けいはんな IHD実験 (Matsukawa 2016, 2018 を要約)
findings.method: Review of Japanese field experiments (author's own RCTs)
findings.interpretation_ja: 日本でも「多い/平均/省エネ」の他者比較で、オール電化世帯は約4〜6%節電したが他の世帯では効果なし。もともと節電していた少量使用世帯は情報で逆に4%増える「ブーメラン効果」。規範メッセージは平均以下の人を平均に引き戻す副作用を入れるべき。
findings.replication: Single-site Japanese experiments; boomerang effect consistent with Schultz et al. 2007

findings.cite: Sasaki S., Saito T., Ohtake F. (2022) Nudges for COVID-19 voluntary vaccination: How to explain peer information? Social Science & Medicine 292:114561
findings.data: Online pre-registered experiment, March 16-18 2021, N=1595 (798 aged 65-74, 797 aged 25-34)
findings.method: RCT: control / social comparison ('7-8 out of 10 in your age group will get vaccinated') / influence-gain / influence-loss messages

numbers.young_adults: no promoting effect of any message

findings.interpretation_ja: 日本の高齢者では「あなたの接種が周りを守る」型が接種意向を約7ポイント上げた。「同年代の7〜8割が接種予定」という記述的規範は、もともと接種したい人の意向を強めるだけで、迷っている人には効かず（むしろ弱める傾向）、若者には全メッセージが無効。規範効果は既存意向で非対称。
findings.replication: Consistent with Moehring et al. 2021 (23-country) for comparison nudge direction; intention not behavior

findings.cite: Tanaka T., Nihonsugi T., Ohtake F., Haruno M. (2021) A message of the majority with scientific evidence encourages young people to show their prosocial nature in COVID-19 vaccination. Scientific Reports 11:23261
findings.method: 9 message conditions incl. 'majority + scientific evidence'

numbers.majority_plus_evidence_effect: increased strong-willingness ratio among males aged 10-20s vs altruistic control (p=0.049)
numbers.other_effects: some messages decreased willingness in males 30s-40s (p=0.041, 0.023)

findings.interpretation_ja: 「多数派が接種する＋科学的根拠」メッセージは若年男性の強い接種意向をわずかに高めた（p=0.049）。効果は小さく層によって逆効果もあり、規範メッセージの効果は属性依存。
findings.page: Abstract; Results (Fig.2); Discussion. NOTE: first author listed in metadata is Toshiko Tanaka; author list from PMC metadata

findings.cite: Acierno J., Tedaldi E., Ginn J., Goldwert D., Vlasceanu M., et al. (2026) Conformity to social norm interventions is not amplified in tighter nations. Communications Psychology 4:68
findings.method: Pre-registered multi-country experiment: dynamic norm, work-together norm, pluralistic ignorance correction vs control; climate beliefs/policy/sharing/tree-planting effort

numbers.behavioral_outcome: tree-planting effort showed backfire across most interventions; Work-Together Norm reduced tree planting vs control

findings.interpretation_ja: 「規範が強い（タイトな）文化ほど規範メッセージが効く」とは言えない。日本＝タイト文化だから同調メッセージを強く設定する、という前提は根拠が弱い。行動指標ではむしろ逆効果も。

findings.cite: Vesely S., Klöckner C.A., et al. (2022) Norms, prices, and commitment: A comprehensive overview of field experiments in the energy domain and treatment effect moderators. Frontiers in Psychology 13:967318
findings.method: Narrative review with effect-size coding (<5% small; 5-10% medium; >10% large)

numbers.conclusion: social norm and incentive interventions mostly achieve small (<5%) reductions; commitment-based effects essentially zero for the most part

findings.interpretation_ja: エネルギー分野の規範介入はほとんど5%未満の小効果。コミットメント（約束）型はほぼゼロ。

findings.cite: Bakshy E., Rosenn I., Marlow C., Adamic L. (2012) The Role of Social Networks in Information Diffusion. WWW 2012; arXiv:1201.4145
findings.data: 253 million subjects; randomized removal of friends' link-share stories from News Feed
findings.method: Field experiment (feed vs no-feed)

numbers.multiple_sharing_friends: absolute difference grows with # sharing friends but relative risk ratio falls
numbers.tie_strength: strong tie (3 comments) 2.83x more likely to cause sharing than no-comment tie, but weak ties responsible for most novel information spread

findings.interpretation_ja: 友人の共有を見ると共有確率は7.4倍（0.025%→0.19%）。ただし1回の露出での共有確率自体は0.2%と非常に低い。友人の共有者数が増えると絶対差は増えるが倍率は下がる（逓減）。強い紐帯は1本あたりは強いが、数の多い弱い紐帯が拡散の主役。
findings.replication: Large RCT; consistent with later Facebook studies

findings.cite: Ugander J., Backstrom L., Marlow C., Kleinberg J. (2012) Structural diversity in social contagion. PNAS 109(16):5962-5966
findings.data: 54 million Facebook invitation emails; ~10 million new users for engagement
findings.method: Observational, conditional conversion rates by contact-neighborhood topology

numbers.key_result: P(join) stratified by number of connected components in contact neighborhood, not by number of contacts; controlling components, neighborhood size is a NEGATIVE predictor; edge density within 1-component neighborhoods has no discernible effect
numbers.exact_rates: reported only in figures on relative scale (1.0 = one-node neighborhood) - not extracted

findings.interpretation_ja: 加入確率は「誘ってくれた人数」ではなく「何種類の別々の人間関係（グループ）から来たか」で決まる。同じグループからの重複露出は効かない。シミュレーターでは露出数ではなく異なるクラスター数で採用確率を上げる設計が妥当。

findings.cite: Centola D., Becker J., Brackbill D., Baronchelli A. (2018) Experimental evidence for tipping points in social convention. Science 360:1116 — as summarized in Guilbeault D., Caplan S., Yang C. (2026) A simple threshold captures the social learning of conventions. PNAS 123(17):e2508061123
findings.data: Name-game experiments in networks with committed minority confederates
findings.method: Secondary citation
findings.interpretation_ja: 固い信念を持つ少数派が全体の約25%に達すると既存の慣習がひっくり返る。それ未満ではほぼ変わらない（閾値的）。
findings.replication: Secondary source (primary Science paper not accessible from allowed hosts) - number unverified against primary
findings.page: PNAS (Guilbeault et al.) Results section on critical mass

findings.cite: Andreoni J., Nikiforakis N., Siegenthaler S. (2021) Predicting social tipping and norm change in controlled experiments. PNAS 118(16):e2014893118
findings.data: Large lab experiment; societies of 20 individuals; 24 societies in main comparisons
findings.method: Coordination game with gradually changing preferences (10% per period chance of switching preference)
findings.interpretation_ja: 規範の転換は、必要な「転換点（離脱者の割合）」が35%未満ならほぼ確実に起き、35%超だとほぼ起きない（同調の罠）。人々が自分で同調コストを決めても高く設定しすぎ、有害な規範が残りやすい。

findings.cite: Mlakar Ž., Bolderdijk J.W., Risselada H., Fennis B.M. (2026) Consistently refusing to go along both helps and hinders minorities to induce social tipping. Scientific Reports 16:10322
findings.method: Multi-round coordination; minority holds 25% average support for alternative; consistent vs inconsistent minority
findings.interpretation_ja: 25%の少数派でも、一貫して主張すると転換確率66%（一貫しないと50%）。ただし頑固すぎると「妥協しない」と見られ逆効果も。

findings.cite: Guilbeault D., Becker J., Centola D. (2018) Complex Contagions: A Decade in Review. arXiv:1710.07606
findings.method: Review citing Fink et al. 2016, Beaman et al., Romero et al. 2011
findings.interpretation_ja: 政治的・社会的コストのある行動（政治ハッシュタグ等）は複数の知人からの強化が必要（遅い採用者の約6割が2人以上の採用者とつながる）。ニュース系は単純伝染（1人で十分、2人以上は1割未満）。商品の種類でsimple/complexを切り替えるべき。

findings.cite: 山口真一 (2020) なぜソーシャルメディア上では極端な意見が多く見られるのか？日韓米の実証分析. 情報社会学会 研究発表大会予稿 2020:25
findings.data: Online survey N=5,986 (JP target 3,000; KR, US 1,000 each)
findings.method: Tobit model of number of SNS posts on opinion extremity

numbers.secondary_Tanaka_Hamaya_2018: ~50,000 Japanese, 2 waves: Twitter users follow tens of % opposite-ideology accounts; no SNS-induced extremization

findings.interpretation_ja: 憲法改正では両極端の意見の人は14.5%しかいないのにSNS投稿の46.1%を占める。意見が1段階極端になると投稿数が約1.7倍。SNS上の意見分布は社会の実態より極端に見える（分極化の多くは「発信の偏り」）。

findings.cite: 辻大介 (2021) ネット社会における世論形成の「分断」. マス・コミュニケーション研究 99:3-
findings.data: National stratified random sample after 2019 upper-house election, ages 18-69, valid N=1,094 (response 50.6%)
findings.method: Generalized ordered probit

numbers.result: hours of PC internet use for personal interests significantly polarizes approval/disapproval of Abe administration (affect-based); mobile internet time n.s.; high political interest -> hard news, low -> soft news (gap widening)

findings.interpretation_ja: 日本でもネット利用（PC）が政権支持・不支持の両極化と関連するが、イデオロギーより感情ベース。関心の高い層と低い層の情報格差が広がる。

findings.cite: 辻大介・北村智 (2018) インターネットでのニュース接触と排外主義的態度の極性化. 情報通信学会誌 36(2):99-
findings.method: Quantile regression

numbers.result: Japan: PC net-news frequency associated with bipolarization of xenophobic attitudes; US: shifts only toward anti-xenophobic

findings.interpretation_ja: ネットニュース接触による分極化の有無は国・文脈次第。日本では排外的態度が両方向に割れる傾向。

findings.cite: 松木祐馬 (2020) テキストベースの討議が個人の態度変容に与える影響. 実験社会心理学研究 59(2):61-
findings.data: N=68 students (two sessions), topic: Japan joining TPP; 6-point scale
findings.method: Experiment, Bayesian ANOVA (ingroup vs anonymous discussants x majority vs minority)
findings.interpretation_ja: ネット討論を読むだけで、少数派は6段階で約0.2ポイント軟化、多数派は匿名討論のときだけ約0.07ポイント極化。集団極性化は日本でも起こるが小さい（尺度の1〜3%程度）。
findings.replication: Small N; Isenberg 1986 meta not accessible

findings.cite: Lurquin J.H., Michaelson L.E., Barker J.E., Gustavson D.E., von Bastian C.C., Carruth N.P., Miyake A. (2016) No Evidence of the Ego-Depletion Effect across Task Characteristics and Individual Differences: A Pre-Registered Study. PLoS ONE 11(2):e0147770
findings.method: Pre-registered experiment

numbers.direction: opposite (depletion group slightly better: M=.39 vs .36)

findings.interpretation_ja: 自我消耗（意志力の消耗）は過去のメタ分析でd=0.62とされたが、事前登録研究では効果なし（むしろ逆方向）。シミュレーターに「意志力消耗」を入れるなら効果はほぼゼロ扱いが安全。
findings.replication: Failed (also Hagger et al. 2016 RRR, d≈0 - not accessed, see hosts_needed)

findings.cite: Metzler H., Grèzes J. (2019) Repeatedly adopting power postures does not affect hormonal correlates of dominance and affiliative behavior. PeerJ 7:e6726
findings.method: Experiment with repeated 2-min postures

numbers.result: no posture effects on testosterone, cortisol, progesterone
numbers.prior_replications: four subsequent studies (Ranehill et al. 2015 etc.) failed to replicate Carney, Cuddy & Yap (2010) hormone effects

findings.interpretation_ja: パワーポーズのホルモン効果は再現されない。

findings.cite: Liebst L.S., Philpot R., Bernasco W., Dausel K.L., Ejbye-Ernst P., Nicolaisen M.H., Lindegaard M.R. (2019) Social relations and presence of others predict bystander intervention: Evidence from violent incidents captured on CCTV. Aggressive Behavior 45(6):598-609
findings.method: Case-control sampling, multilevel logistic regression

numbers.Fischer2011_meta_secondary: bystander effect attenuates or reverses in high-danger contexts

findings.interpretation_ja: 実際の暴力場面でも、居合わせる人数が1SD増えると各個人が介入するオッズは約0.28倍（古典的傍観者効果）。ただし当事者と知り合いだと介入オッズは20倍以上で、人数効果より大きい。
findings.replication: Field data; consistent with classical effect at individual level; group-level helping (Philpot 2020, 90% of incidents) not accessed

findings.cite: Gächter S., Herrmann B., Thöni C. (2010) Culture and cooperation. Phil Trans R Soc B 365:2651-2661 (re-analysis of Herrmann, Thöni & Gächter 2008 Science)
findings.country: 16 subject pools (no Japan; Asian pools: Seoul, Chengdu)
findings.data: 1,120 participants; groups of 4; 10 periods; 20 ECU endowment; MPCR 0.4
findings.method: Public goods game without (N) and with (P) costly punishment (1 ECU cost : 3 ECU reduction)

numbers.decline: contributions decline over periods in all pools except Athens, Riyadh, Muscat
numbers.punishment_effect: contributions significantly higher with punishment in 4 of 6 cultures

findings.interpretation_ja: 公共財ゲームでは協力（拠出）は回を追うごとにほぼ必ず低下。罰の機会があると多くの文化で拠出が上がるが、協力者を罰する「反社会的罰」の多さは文化差が大きい。個人差より集団差（30%）が大きく、文化差は4%程度。日本のデータはこの研究に含まれない。
findings.replication: Decay is near-universal; Japan numbers from Herrmann 2008 do not exist (not a subject pool)

findings.cite: Shirado H., Fu F., Fowler J.H., Christakis N.A. (2013) Quality versus quantity of social ties in experimental cooperative networks. Nature Communications 4:2814
findings.method: Networked cooperation game with rewiring rates 0-100%

numbers.pattern: cooperation declines at 0%, 30%, 100% rewiring; maintained at 70% (Goldilocks)

findings.interpretation_ja: 初回の協力率は約65%。関係の組み替え（離脱・再接続）が適度（70%程度）なときに協力が最も維持される。

findings.cite: 清成透子・山岸俊男 (1999) 分配委任ゲームを用いた信頼と信頼性の比較研究. 社会心理学研究 15(2):100-
findings.method: 'Game of enthronement' separating trust from trustworthiness

numbers.trustworthiness: no significant difference (e.g., 643.7 vs 614.2 yen returned; t(218)=.87 ns)
numbers.abstract: Americans higher trust than Japanese; no difference in trustworthiness

findings.interpretation_ja: 米国人の方が日本人より見知らぬ相手を信頼する（約8〜12ポイント高い）が、信頼に応える度合いは日米で同程度。日本は「安心社会」で、信頼は低めだが裏切りが多いわけではない。
findings.replication: UNVERIFIED mapping: scanned PDF lost Japanese labels; which sample is JP vs US inferred from abstract (US higher) and n. Consistent with Yamagishi & Yamagishi 1994

findings.cite: Romano A., Balliet D., Yamagishi T., Liu J.H. (2017) Parochial trust and cooperation across 17 societies. PNAS 114(48):12702-12707
findings.method: Trust game (endowment 5 MU, tripled) with ingroup (same nationality)/outgroup/stranger partners; reputation manipulation
findings.interpretation_ja: 同じ国籍の相手には5単位中約0.19単位多く送る（約4%）。評判がかかる（相手に自分の国籍が知られる）と信頼が同程度増える。内集団ひいきは主に「身内からの見返り期待」で説明される。日本を含め普遍的。
findings.replication: Multi-country; Japan-specific estimates in SI only (not extracted)

findings.cite: Balliet D., Wu J., De Dreu C.K.W. (2014) Ingroup favoritism in cooperation: A meta-analysis. Psych Bull 140:1556 — as cited in Everett J.A.C., Faber N.S., Crockett M. (2015) Front Behav Neurosci 9:15
findings.method: Secondary citation

numbers.ingroup_love_vs_outgroup_hate: ingroup love stronger than outgroup derogation

findings.interpretation_ja: 身内びいきの効果量は、相互依存がある協力場面でd=0.42（中程度）、一方的に分けるだけ（独裁者ゲーム）でd=0.19。外集団を嫌うより身内を優遇する効果が主。
findings.page: Everett et al. section on bounded generalized reciprocity

findings.cite: 神信人・山岸俊男・清成透子 (1996) 双方向依存性と“最小条件集団パラダイム”. 心理学研究 67(2):77-85
findings.method: Minimal group paradigm, bilateral vs unilateral dependency

numbers.result: ingroup bias in reward allocation only in bilateral-dependency condition; none in unilateral; only those with illusion of control showed bias

findings.interpretation_ja: 日本の最小条件集団実験では、自分の報酬が他者の分配に依存する（お互い様）ときだけ内集団ひいきが出る。単なるラベルではなく「身内からの見返り期待」が原因。
findings.replication: Consistent with Karp et al. 1993; numbers not extracted (scanned PDF)

findings.cite: Ward P.R., Mamerow L., Meyer S.B. (2014) Interpersonal trust across six Asia-Pacific countries. PLoS ONE 9(4):e95555
findings.country: Japan (and AU, HK, KR, TW, TH)
findings.method: Survey
findings.interpretation_ja: 日本では近所の人を高く信頼する人が約8割だが、見知らぬ人は33%、外国人は28%。身内と他人で信頼の差が大きい（信頼の半径が狭い）。※一般的信頼の全国値は別担当。

findings.cite: Dorrough A.R., Glöckner A., Hellmann D.M., Ebert I. (2015) The development of ingroup favoritism in repeated social dilemmas. Frontiers in Psychology 6:476
findings.method: Repeated continuous PD with 10 ingroup then 10 outgroup partners (or reverse)

numbers.result: no initial ingroup-outgroup difference in cooperation; clear ingroup favoritism after repeated interaction, driven by partner group change after round 10

findings.interpretation_ja: 身内びいきは最初からあるとは限らず、繰り返しのやり取りで後から生じる。

findings.cite: Chan M.S., Jones C.R., Hall Jamieson K., Albarracín D. (2017) Debunking: A Meta-Analysis of the Psychological Efficacy of Messages Countering Misinformation. Psychological Science 28(11):1531-1546
findings.method: Meta-analysis

numbers.moderators: persistence stronger & debunking weaker when audiences generate reasons supporting misinformation; detailed debunking increases both debunking and persistence

findings.interpretation_ja: 誤情報を見せると信念は大きく動き（d≈2.4〜3.1）、訂正で戻るのは半分程度（d≈1.1〜1.3）、訂正後も誤信念が残る（d≈0.75〜1.06）。シミュレーターでは「訂正で誤信念の約4〜6割を解消、残りは持続」が目安。

findings.cite: 山口真一・谷原吏 (2024) 偽・誤情報拡散行動と真偽判断・リテラシーの関係：日本におけるコロナワクチンと政治の偽・誤情報に関する実証分析. 情報社会学会 研究発表大会予稿 2022:145
findings.data: Online survey Feb 10-23 2022; 12 fact-checked misinformation items (6 vaccine, 6 political); vaccine sample 8,169 obs (4,469 persons); political 2,920 obs (1,841 persons)
findings.method: Logit, marginal effects, SE clustered by item

numbers.literacy: media & information literacy significantly reduce spreading
numbers.Vosoughi2018_secondary: false news ~70% more likely to be retweeted than truth

findings.interpretation_ja: 日本で偽情報に接した人の約2割（ワクチン21.8%、政治24.0%）が何らかの形で拡散（SNSだけでなく口頭も含む）。信じた人は信じていない人より拡散確率が14〜24ポイント高い。政治では「嘘だと思う人」も拡散（批判目的）する点に注意。
findings.replication: Single survey; consistent with international literature

findings.cite: Swire-Thompson B., Cook J., Butler L.H., Sanderson J.A., Lewandowsky S., Ecker U.K.H. (2021) Correction format has a limited role when debunking misinformation. Cognitive Research: Principles and Implications 6:83
findings.method: Experiments comparing myth-first, fact-first, fact-only, myth-only corrections

numbers.result: impact of correction on belief largely independent of format; myth-first slightly better after delay in Exp.4; familiarity backfire not supported

findings.interpretation_ja: 訂正の書き方（神話を先に書くか事実を先に書くか）は効果にほとんど影響しない。「訂正が逆効果になる（バックファイア）」は起きにくい。
